deliberation: Revision 1 composes POL, AETHER, AETHER-Learn, FABRIC, GHOS, AETHER-MEM, sidecars, and distributed truth without collapsing their authority roles.
discharged_obligations: Checked whole-system coherence and end-to-end composition across the proposed planes.
findings: The end-to-end cycle can preserve institutional meaning while delegating physical realization.
A cross-plane correlation model can reconstruct operations without collapsing event semantics.
conditions: E1 should publish one canonical end-to-end sequence and correlation model.
AETHER-MEM and sidecars must retain semantic identity and provenance in AETHER while FABRIC handles physical locality and movement only.
Distributed-truth semantic cuts and fencing must remain AETHER responsibilities.
Do not introduce another telemetry plane without evidence that owning-plane telemetry is insufficient.
residual_uncertainty: High-performance paths may require co-designed interfaces, which must not become semantic collapse.
